clips.title: The story
paras: Rough Wolf Pelts is an introductory skinning quest in Elwynn Forest offered by Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire. With her husband away assisting near Northshire Abbey, Helene relies on capable skinners to harvest raw hides from local wolves to complete her pending leatherworking orders.

Just outside Goldshire, Helene Peltskinner works diligently to supply travelers and residents with cured leather and furs. While her husband typically hunts the prowling timber wolves of Elwynn Forest to keep her workshop supplied, duties near Northshire Abbey have taken him away from the workbench. Left with a backlog of customer orders to finish, Helene enlists the aid of passing apprentices willing to turn their skinning knives toward the local wildlife.

The dense woodlands of Elwynn Forest teem with timber wolves that stalk the edges of farmlands and roadways. For novice skinners, gathering rough wolf pelts serves as practical field experience in the trade of hide harvesting. Delivering these skins allows Helene to maintain her business and keep trade flowing through Goldshire, while providing wandering hunters a chance to hone their woodcraft.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any luck with those wolf pelts?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work collecting these pelts, adventurer. You have a real talent for hunting.
